flags.item: Next Gen Stats Week 2 passing table
flags.detail: The official page rendered only the NGS logo shell on 4 attempts; Week 2 QB rows are left blank and excluded from prop work.
nfl.com labels the game 'Sunday Night Football, September 9th', but 2026-09-09 is a Wednesday. Recorded verbatim.
The schedule render labels kickoff times 'LOCAL' without naming a time zone; times are shown exactly as rendered. Root data/schedule-2026-week9.json labels the same times ET.

The standings legend does not name columns 14 and 16. Their values equal each team's non-conference record and last-5 record for 32/32 teams (arithmetic proof in results/standings-reconciliation.json); the labels are inferred, the values are official.
Some team-weeks have no NGS row (e.g. TB Week 7; JAX and TB Week 8). These team-games are excluded, never filled.
Each line assumes the team's most recent NGS passer starts. Starters are not confirmed by an official source here; check the official injury report before use.

flags.item: Week 9 lines ignore injuries and QB changes
flags.detail: Ratings use final scores only. Example: per NGS, BAL's Week 8 passer was Joe Fagnano; a score-only model cannot price such changes.
0 of 12 strategies passed G1–G8; Week 9 lines are published as UNVALIDATED estimates, not proven edges. Best: S1 (spread MAE -1.7% vs baseline, Holm p = 0.32).

flags.item: Market-dependent strategies (incl. root dashboard W9 candidates)
flags.detail: No official source publishes sportsbook prices, so any 'edge vs book' strategy fails G8 here. The root dashboard's W9 candidates rely on data/market-lines.json (flagged unverified by earlier sessions; see 74efc1ec audit).

First render of the Week 2 scores page showed 9 games as 'Hidden Score'; one Week 6 render was an empty skeleton. Re-fetching the same official URLs showed all values; every score is confirmed by the 512/512 standings reconciliation.

Two sessions claim root integration (5c4b8a3e, dd321bf5); open PRs #8 and #11 edit the same root files; 74efc1ec merged PRs #7/#9/#10 directly; PR #6 is stale; this session force-pushed its own branch once after rebasing its claim commit (content unchanged).
